name: bruiser
description: Bruiser-aware agent convenience tools. Enforcement never depends on MCP; unaware clients are still subject to the same customer-level rules via Edge or Proxy.

tools.name: bruiser_session
tools.description: Exchange a merchant-signed customer assertion for a Bruiser session bound to this principal.

assertion.description: Merchant customer assertion (OIDC or HS256 JWT)

tools.name: bruiser_acquire
tools.description: Acquire an execution lease for a scarce resource. Returns GRANTED, ALREADY_HELD, QUEUED, or BUSY.

tools.name: bruiser_renew
tools.description: Heartbeat: extend an ACTIVE lease TTL.

tools.name: bruiser_release
tools.description: Release an ACTIVE execution so another of the same customer's agents may be granted or promoted from the intra-customer queue.

tools.name: bruiser_watch
tools.description: Long-poll an execution or queued waiter until state changes.

tools.name: bruiser_handoff
tools.description: Transfer an execution to another principal of the same customer (preempt or cooperative).
